title: Pvp X Optimization
description: High-performance PvP modpack powered by VulkanMod, delivering ultra-smooth FPS, low input delay, and a clean, stable experience without GUI glitches or crashes.
body:
⚡ Pvp X Optimization

Pvp X Optimization is a performance-focused Minecraft modpack designed for smooth gameplay, high FPS, and competitive PvP. Built around VulkanMod, this pack delivers a fast and responsive experience while avoiding common rendering issues like GUI flickering and crashes.

🚀 What this modpack does

This modpack is carefully optimized to:

Maximize FPS on low to mid-range PCs
Reduce input delay for better PvP performance
Provide a clean, distraction-free interface
Ensure stable gameplay without visual bugs

Every mod is selected to improve performance without breaking Vulkan rendering.

⚙️ Key Features
🎯 High Performance
Significant FPS boost compared to vanilla
Reduced lag spikes and smoother frame pacing
Optimized memory and CPU usage
🧠 Stability First
Removed incompatible rendering mods
Fixed common issues like:
GUI blinking
Shader crashes
Tested for stable VulkanMod usage
🎮 PvP Focused
Clean HUD and minimal UI distractions
Fast menu navigation
Better responsiveness in fights
🛠️ Built With

Includes powerful optimization mods such as:

Lithium
FerriteCore
Krypton
EntityCulling

Combined with VulkanMod for advanced rendering performance.

⚠️ Important Notes
This modpack is designed specifically for VulkanMod
Adding shader or heavy rendering mods may cause crashes
Recommended RAM: 4GB–6GB
Use fullscreen mode for best results
💻 Who is this for?
PvP players (Lifesteal, Practice, etc.)
Players with low-end or mid-range PCs
Anyone who wants high FPS + stability without glitches
🔥 Goal of this pack

To provide a simple, fast, and stable PvP experience without unnecessary features — just pure performance and smooth gameplay.
